name: Alternative API Styles & Protocol Governance
description: Governing the selection, standardization, and federation of non-REST API styles across the organization — GraphQL, gRPC, AsyncAPI, WebSocket, and streaming protocols. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: Backend's be_api_design.graphql_apis covers writing resolvers, DataLoader batching, and SDL schemas for a single service (implementation); Backend's be_api_design.grpc_protobuf covers writing .proto files and streaming RPC handlers (implementation). API Design's api_alternative_styles covers deciding WHEN each protocol is appropriate organization-wide, governing GraphQL schema federation across teams, managing Protobuf schema registries, and authoring AsyncAPI event-driven specifications as platform standards (strategic/architectural decision-making).

subskills.name: GraphQL Schema Governance & Standards
subskills.description: Governing GraphQL schema design across teams — naming conventions, nullable vs non-nullable field policies, pagination standards (Relay Connection spec), query depth and complexity limits, and schema review processes before merging to the federated graph.

subskills.name: gRPC Service Contract Standards
subskills.description: Establishing organization-wide gRPC service contract conventions — .proto file structure standards, package naming, field numbering policies, service method naming, backward-compatible Protobuf evolution rules, and gRPC status code mapping governance.

subskills.name: AsyncAPI Event-Driven Specifications
subskills.description: Authoring AsyncAPI specifications for event-driven APIs — channel naming standards, message payload schemas, bindings for Kafka/AMQP/WebSocket, event catalog governance, and code generation from AsyncAPI documents.

subskills.name: WebSocket API Design Patterns
subskills.description: Designing WebSocket API contracts — connection lifecycle management, message framing standards (JSON-RPC over WebSocket, custom protocols), heartbeat/ping-pong intervals, reconnection strategies, and authentication during WebSocket upgrade.

subskills.name: JSON-RPC & RPC-Style API Specifications
subskills.description: Designing JSON-RPC 2.0 compliant APIs — request/response envelope standards, error object structures, batch request handling, notification (fire-and-forget) patterns, and when RPC-style APIs are preferred over REST resource-oriented designs.

subskills.name: API Protocol Selection Decision Framework
subskills.description: Creating organizational decision frameworks for API protocol selection — REST vs GraphQL vs gRPC vs WebSocket vs AsyncAPI trade-off matrices, use-case matching criteria (latency, payload size, streaming, browser support), and technology radar governance.

subskills.name: API Federation & Schema Composition
subskills.description: Designing federated API architectures — GraphQL Federation (Apollo Federation 2), gRPC service mesh composition, API gateway aggregation patterns, and ownership boundaries for federated subgraph schemas across autonomous teams.

subskills.name: Schema Registry & Contract Repository
subskills.description: Operating centralized schema registries — Confluent Schema Registry for Avro/Protobuf/JSON Schema, Apicurio Registry, schema versioning and compatibility modes (BACKWARD, FORWARD, FULL), and automated schema validation in CI pipelines.

subskills.name: Streaming API Architecture Patterns
subskills.description: Designing streaming API patterns at the platform level — Server-Sent Events (SSE) vs WebSocket vs gRPC streaming selection criteria, backpressure contract standards, stream lifecycle management, and long-lived connection governance.
